task.title: RLlib production PPO on TWSE trading env
task.summary_zh: 把 OSS-RLLIB-001 PPO skeleton 升級到 production：用 TWSE OHLCV 作為環境的 observation/action space，跑 ≥100 iter PPO，輸出 model_artifact 含 trained_policy 與 evaluation_summary，提交 registry admission packet。CPU-only。獨立檔案。
acceptance: twse_trading_env.py defines a gymnasium-compatible env wrapping TWSE OHLCV (5-instrument universe) with discrete action space (hold long short)
production_ppo_run.py runs ≥ 100 PPO iterations CPU-only and asserts mean_reward improves vs random baseline
model_artifact registered with checksum and trained_policy_ref
test fixture trains ≥ 10 iterations and asserts loss decreases
